channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: “At This Level, Everything Is Precise”: How Pigalle's Founder Made Swaggy Olympic Gear (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Stéphane Ashpool, founder of buzzy streetwear label Pigalle, designed France's 2026 Winter Olympic uniforms. "At this level, everything is precise," he says.

item.title: Say Aloha to adidas' Most Military-Minded Skate Shoe
item.description: adidas' Aloha Super sneaker is a mix between an adidas skate shoe & a German Military Trainer.

item.title: Why Is Menswear Obsessed With Natural Fibers?
item.description: The natural fiber fetish is taking off thanks to brands like Dana Lee Brown, Evan Kinori, and Margaret Howell. But what does it actually mean?

item.title: On's Most Stylish Running Shoe Is For Fashion Essentialists
item.description: Swiss brand On's Cloudtilt Remix is a quiet luxury-style running sneaker that blends performance tech with everyday wearability.

item.title: Fast & Fluorescent, Nike ACG's Trail Runner Is Built to Glow in the Grime
item.description: Fresh off the press over at its ACG outdoor line, the boldly colored UltraFly Trail might be one of Nike's fastest, most terrain-defiant running shoes yet.

item.title: sacai Made Carhartt Formalwear a Thing
item.description: In the Carhartt WIP blazer, sacai's bringing together two polar opposites: rugged workwear and elegant formalwear. Somehow, it works.

item.title: Six Years of adidas Collabs, One Exquisite Italian Wales Bonner Sneaker
item.description: The Wales Bonner Paris Trainer is similar to the great adidas x Wales Bonner sneakers that preceded it. Except, it's made in Italy and it comes sans adidas.

item.title: Court or Clubhouse, Roger Federer & On Remain A Game-Set-Match Made in Heaven
item.description: The latest drop comes in the form of two similar yet slightly altered silhouettes: On THE ROGER Clubhouse Ace 1 M and On THE ROGER Center Court 1 M.

item.title: Nike's Teched-Out Dad Shoe Comes With Its Own Leather Trench Coat
item.description: Nike upgraded its P-6000 dad shoe with a full leather upper that's almost too luxe to function.

item.title: These Chrome-Clad adidas Are Made For the Streets, Not the Pitch
item.description: Capturing the unforgettable visual identity of the OG Predator, the adidas Predator 94 ST swaps studs for a road-ready white midsole and gum outsole.
